defs.def: to give people information about sth that you have heard, seen, done, etc. 汇报；报告；通报

ex.s: A recent study reported that native communities in Peru noticed a change in the smell of the Amazon River due to industrial pollution.
ex.t: 最近一项研究报告称，秘鲁的原住民社区注意到，由于工业污染，亚马逊河的气味发生了变化。

ex.s: We found that those rated as more moral reported a stronger sense of well-being.
ex.t: 我们发现，那些被评为更具道德感的人报告了更强的幸福感。

ex.s: And Priscilla Dewing reports that her horse, Nappy, “moves more easily and rides more comfortably” after a chiropractic adjustment.
ex.t: 普丽西拉·杜因也报告说，她的马纳皮在接受脊椎按摩调整后“行动更自如，骑起来也更舒适”。

ex.s: Most frequently, the groups reported that they “shared arguments and reasoned together.” Somehow, these arguments and reasoning resulted in a global reduction in error.
ex.t: 最常见的是，各小组报告说他们“分享论点并一起推理”。不知何故，这些论点和推理使错误总体上减少了。

ex.s: I couldn’t ____33____ her,” Bailey told the reporter.
ex.t: 我不能____33____她，”贝利告诉记者。

ex.s: Staff in care homes have reported a reduction in the use of medicine where hens are in use.
ex.t: 养老院的员工报告说，在使用母鸡的地方，药物的使用量有所减少。

ex.s: He's a news reporter.
ex.t: 他是一名新闻记者。

ex.s: I reported the strange surface on the skin of the lizard to my husband and children the next morning.
ex.t: 第二天早上我把蜥蜴皮肤上的异常情况报告给了丈夫和孩子。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 成为下一个明星记者、新闻撰稿人、导演或制片人。

ex.s: Meet a star reporter.
ex.t: 见一位明星记者。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter, news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 成为下一个明星记者、新闻撰稿人、导演或制片人。

ex.s: The results showed that those who chatted with their server reported significantly higher positive feelings and a better coffee shop experience.
ex.t: 结果显示，与服务员聊天的人报告说积极情绪明显更高，咖啡店体验更好。

ex.s: “Jazz seems like it’s not really a part of the American appetite,” Moran tells National Public Radio’s reporter Neal Conan.
ex.t: “爵士乐似乎并非真正符合美国人的胃口，”莫兰告诉美国国家公共广播电台记者尼尔·科南。

ex.s: Already this year, 115 measles cases have been reported in the USA, compared with 189 for all of last year.
ex.t: 仅今年，美国已报告115例麻疹病例，而去年全年为189例。

ex.s: That’s exactly what is happening in small neighborhoods around the country from Orange County, California, where 22 measles cases were reported this month, to Brooklyn, N.Y., where a 17-year-old caused an outbreak last year.
ex.t: 这正是全国小社区正在发生的事情，从加州奥兰治县（本月报告了22例麻疹）到纽约布鲁克林（去年一名17岁少年引发了疫情）。

ex.s: On Thursday in an article published in Cell, a team of researchers reported a new kind of adaptation - not to air or to food, but to the ocean.
ex.t: 周四在《细胞》杂志发表的一篇文章中，一组研究人员报告了一种新的适应——不是针对空气或食物，而是针对海洋。

ex.s: Report their needs and feedback.
ex.t: 报告他们的需求和反馈。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美感组报告的“蜕变性和超越自我的感受”——如感动、受启迪、受鼓舞——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
ex.t: 然而重要的是，美感组并没有报告比对照组更快乐，这表明影响抽象思维的是与美的接触，而不是这次经历带来的整体积极情绪。

ex.s: Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.
ex.t: 去年，该基金会报告称，近60%的7至12岁儿童说他们白天感到疲倦，15%说他们在学校里睡着了。

ex.s: Back in 1983, two scientists, Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin, reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温就报告说，遭受昆虫啃咬的年轻枫树会散发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物能够感知到。

ex.s: Back in 1983,two scientists,Jack Schultz and Ian Baldwin,reported that young maple trees getting bitten by insects send out a particular smell that neighboring plants can get.
ex.t: 早在1983年，两位科学家杰克·舒尔茨和伊恩·鲍德温就报告说，被昆虫啃咬的幼枫树会发出一种特殊的气味，邻近的植物可以接收到。

ex.s: “People who live in plant-rich environments report a higher life satisfaction rating, ” she says.
ex.t: “生活在植物丰富环境中的人报告了更高的生活满意度评分，”她说。

ex.s: In recent years some Inuit people in Nunayut   65   (report) increases in bear sightings around human settlements, leading to a   66   (believe) that populations are increasing.
ex.t: 近年来，努纳武特地区的一些因纽特人报告称，人类定居点附近目击北极熊的事件有所增加，导致人们相信种群数量在增加。

defs.def: to present a written or spoken account of an event in a newspaper, on television, etc. 报道；公布；发表；宣布

ex.s: But, according to the Merriam-Webster New Book of Word Histories, the first typhoons reported in the English language were in India and were called “touffons” or “tufans,” The word tufan or al-tufan is Arabic and means violent storm or flood.
ex.t: 但据《梅里亚姆-韦伯斯特单词史新书》记载，英语中最早被报道的台风出现在印度，被称为“touffons”或“tufans”，tufan或al-tufan这个词来自阿拉伯语，意思是猛烈的风暴或洪水。

ex.s: As reported by a local newspaper, Bailey was more than two-thirds of the way through her ____24____ when a runner in front of her began crying in pain.
ex.t: 据当地一家报纸报道，贝利在____24____已完成超过三分之二时，她前面的一名跑步者开始痛苦地哭喊。

ex.s: The Machine Stops Instead of being printed, the Earth Chronicle is every morning spoken to subscribers, who, in interesting conversations with reporters, statesmen, and scientists, learn the news of the day.
ex.t: 机器停止了 每天早晨，《地球纪事》不再是印刷出来的，而是读给订阅者听，他们通过与记者、政治家和科学家的有趣对话了解当天的新闻。

defs.def: （不知传言是否确凿）据说，传闻

ex.s: And just like crypto currencies, there are those who think the islanders are smart to invest in this type of money, which is reported to have risen in value over the last three decades.
ex.t: 就像加密货币一样，也有人认为岛民投资这类货币是聪明的，据报道这类货币在过去三十年里价值已经上升。

ex.s: It’s been reported that 76 percent of employees in some western countries are using emojis at work.
ex.t: 据报道，一些西方国家76%的员工在工作中使用表情符号。

ex.s: It is recently reported that the number of those sticking to a traditional diet is slowly declining and around half of Britain’s consumers would like to change or improve their cooking in some way.
ex.t: 最近有报道称，坚持传统饮食的人数正在缓慢下降，大约一半的英国消费者希望以某种方式改变或改进自己的烹饪。

defs.def: to tell a person in authority about a crime, an accident, an illness, etc. or about sth bad that sb has done 举报；告发

ex.s: If your card has been reported to the Police as stolen, please also call into the SAC to request a replacement, bringing with you a copy of your Police Crime Report paperwork.
ex.t: 如果你的卡已向警方报告被盗请也致电SAC申请换卡并带上一份警方犯罪报告文件副本。

defs.def: to tell sb that you have arrived, for example for work or for a meeting with sb 报到

ex.s: Reporter: And what sort of work are you doing to help solve these problems?
ex.t: 记者：那么你们正在做哪些工作来帮助解决这些问题？

defs.def: a written or spoken account of an event, especially one that is published or broadcast 报道

ex.s: However, according to a report by the World Wildlife Fund, tourists ____18____ (leave) over 1.3 billion tons of food waste last year, ____19____ accounted for about 8% of the total global gas release in 2024.
ex.t: 然而，根据世界自然基金会的一份报告，游客去年____18____（leave 留下）超过13亿吨食物垃圾，____19____（占）2024年全球气体排放总量约8%。

ex.s: From the English side, we have scientific reports and the captain’s record of that terrible day.
ex.t: 从英方那里，我们有科学报告和船长对那可怕一天的记录。

ex.s: There ____17____(be) a dramatic rise in the number of extreme weather events over the past 20 years,____18____(cause) largely by rising global temperatures,according to a new report from the United Nations.
ex.t: 过去20年来极端天气事件的数量出现了____17____(be)急剧上升____18____(cause)主要原因是全球气温升高根据联合国的一份最新报告．

ex.s: A news reportB.
ex.t: 一则新闻报道。

ex.s: A news report.
ex.t: 一篇新闻报道。

ex.s: However, I soon   45   that much has changed since the days of disturbing reports of   46   among tons of rubbish.
ex.t: 然而，我很快发现在那些关于垃圾成堆的令人不安的报告之后，情况已经发生了很大变化。

ex.s: A new report found 46 percent of meals are eaten alone in America.
ex.t: 一份新的报告发现，在美国46%的餐食是独自进食的。

ex.s: Only at dinnertime are we eating together anymore，74 percent，according to statistics from the report.
ex.t: 只有晚餐时我们才会聚在一起吃饭——74%，根据该报告的统计数据。

ex.s: While the decline over the past decade is steep for teen readers, some data in the report shows that reading remains a big part of many children’s lives, and indicates how parents might help encourage more reading.
ex.t: 虽然过去十年青少年读者的下降幅度很大，但报告中的一些数据显示阅读仍然是许多儿童生活中的重要部分，并表明家长可能如何帮助鼓励更多阅读。

ex.s: The report data shows that pleasure reading levels for younger children, ages 2-8, remain largely the same.
ex.t: 报告数据显示，2-8岁儿童的娱乐性阅读水平基本保持不变。

ex.s: The most hopeful data shared in the report shows clear evidence of parents serving as examples and important guides for their kids when it comes to reading.
ex.t: 报告中分享的最令人振奋的数据清楚地表明，在阅读方面，家长为孩子树立榜样和发挥重要引导作用。

ex.s: What is the Common Sense Media report probably about?
ex.t: 常识媒体的报告可能是关于什么的？

ex.s: More than 23 percent of adults and 80 percent of adolescents don't get enough physical activity, and according to a 2019 report from the World Health Organization.
ex.t: 超过23%的成年人和80%的青少年运动量不足，而根据世界卫生组织2019年的一份报告。

ex.s: Reports on scientific discoveries.
ex.t: 关于科学发现的报道。

ex.s: And there's a handy traffic report, too!
ex.t: 还有一个方便的交通报告！

ex.s: Teens and younger children are reading a lot less for fun, according to a Common Sense Media report published Monday.
ex.t: 根据常识媒体周一发布的一份报告，青少年和更小的孩子为了娱乐而阅读的时间大大减少了。

defs.def: a spoken or written description of sth containing information that sb needs to have 汇报；报告；记述

ex.s: Giving a report.
ex.t: 作报告。

ex.s: To submit a book report.
ex.t: 提交读书报告。

ex.s: •Weekly progress reports for all pair meetings
ex.t: •每次双人见面会提交周进度报告

ex.s: His report was scientific.
ex.t: 他的报告是科学的。

ex.s: I can finish the report on my own.
ex.t: 我可以独自完成这份报告。

ex.s: Writing a lab report.
ex.t: 写实验报告。

ex.s: Writing a lab report.
ex.t: 写实验报告。

ex.s: To collect data for her report.
ex.t: 为她的报告收集数据。

ex.s: Praising the effort and not the outcome can also mean recognizing your child when she has worked hard to clean the yard, cook dinner, or finish a book report.
ex.t: 表扬努力而非结果，也意味着当孩子努力清理院子、做晚饭或完成一份读书报告时认可他。

ex.s: Ask them to write book reports.
ex.t: 要求他们写读书报告。

ex.s: Write a report.
ex.t: 写报告。

ex.s: 11．（1分）Bob thought he couldn't go to the party because he had to write a report， but he went                ．（  ）
ex.t: 11．（1分）鲍勃以为他不能去参加派对，因为他得写一份报告，但他却去了（  ）。

ex.s: Nor could the use of smartphones and the Internet be entirely the ___55___, the report said, since the decline began before they were widely available.
ex.t: 报告称，智能手机和互联网的使用也不可能是___55___（原因），因为这一下降在开始广泛使用它们之前就已经开始了。

ex.s: When you see the capitalized “WHO” in a medical report, do you read it as the “who” in “Who’s that?
ex.t: 当你在医学报告中看到大写的＂WHO＂时，你是把它读作＂Who's that＂中的＂who＂吗？

ex.s: At the school clinic, a doctor, with a serious expression on his face, handed me a medical report.
ex.t: 在校医务室，一位医生表情严肃地递给我一份体检报告。

ex.s: If we want to reconstruct what was actually going on that day, the shield must be questioned and interpreted as deeply and strictly as the written reports.
ex.t: 如果我们想还原那天实际发生的事情，就必须像对待文字报告一样，深入而严格地追问和解读这面盾。

ex.s: “It doesn't feel as alone as it may have before al the advances in technology,” said Laurie Demerit， whose company provided the statistics for the report.
ex.t: "随着技术的进步，这不像以前那样让人觉得孤单了，"劳里·德默里特说道，她的公司为这份报告提供了统计数据。

defs.def: an official document written by a group of people who have examined a particular situation or problem 调查报告

ex.s: Official reports suggest that the number of households with three generations living together had risen from 325,000 in 2002 to 419,000 in 2013.
ex.t: 官方报告显示，三代同堂的家庭数量从2002年的325,000户增加到2013年的419,000户。

ex.s: Reporter: What’s the biggest problem faced by SNNR?
ex.t: 记者：SNNR面临的最大问题是什么？

a written statement about a student's work at school, college, etc. 成绩报告单

ex.s: Work permit and Academic report.
ex.t: 工作许可和学业成绩单。

the sound of an explosion or of a gun being fired 爆炸声；射击声

ex.s: The man-on-the-street interview is an interview in which a reporter hits the streets with a cameraman to interview people on the sport. _____31_____ But with these tips, your first man-on-the-street interview experience can be easy.
ex.t: 街头采访是一种记者带着摄像师走上街头就某个话题采访路人的方式。_____31_____ 但有了这些建议，你的第一次街头采访经历可以变得轻松愉快。
